purpose: Resolve the four C2-LT-B4 local-review issue rows into duplicate-lineage, official-guideline-page, DOI or fulltext-route candidates without changing artifact promotion or model admission status.

nonClaims: This register does not change any source into reviewed evidence.
This register does not create reviewed artifacts, Source Cards, variable cards, endpoint cards, uncertainty cards, transfer-boundary cards or downgrade rows.
This register does not authorize model admission, individual advice, individual death-date output, clinical validity claims or intervention ranking.
This register only prepares source-route candidates that must pass manual/fulltext extraction and independent fresh review before bounded artifact use.

verificationSources.useBoundary: Use only for source identity, DOI, PMCID, abstract-availability and bibliographic lineage; not for extracting clinical recommendations or effect claims.

verificationSources.useBoundary: Use only to identify fulltext route and source identity for later fresh review; not for individual liver-disease guidance or calibrated prognosis.

verificationSources.useBoundary: Use only for source-route and terminology normalization; exact claims require fulltext/manual review and independent fresh review.

resolutionRows.originalRegisteredTitle: Hyperglycemic Crises in Adults With Diabetes: A Consensus Report

currentSourceCheck.observedTitle: PMID 39052901 resolves to the Diabetes Care route of the adult hyperglycemic crises consensus report; PMID 38907161 resolves to the Diabetologia route of the same consensus report lineage.

sourceResolutionCandidates.title: Hyperglycaemic crises in adults with diabetes: a consensus report
sourceResolutionCandidates.resolutionFinding: PMID 38907161 is the Diabetologia spelling route for the adult hyperglycaemic crises consensus report and should be treated as the same consensus lineage as EXT-002 unless a reviewer explicitly assigns separate route roles.
sourceResolutionCandidates.useBoundary: Use only after independent fresh review for consensus-route lineage and adult hyperglycemic-crisis vocabulary; do not count as independent evidence or generate individual care advice.

sourceResolutionCandidates.title: Hyperglycemic Crises in Adults With Diabetes: A Consensus Report
sourceResolutionCandidates.resolutionFinding: PMID 39052901 is a valid Diabetes Care publication route for the same adult hyperglycemic crises consensus report lineage and should remain duplicate-route evidence unless fresh review proves a distinct source role.
sourceResolutionCandidates.useBoundary: Use only after independent fresh review as duplicate/companion route lineage; no independent evidence counting, intervention ranking, individual advice or calibrated outcome claim.

requiredFreshReviewActions: Verify whether EXT-001 and EXT-002 share identical or materially overlapping consensus content.
Choose one evidence-counting anchor or explicitly mark one row as duplicate-route companion.
Re-extract exact claim, endpoint, population/setting, uncertainty, transfer boundary, downgrade triggers and model position from the retained route after duplicate handling.
Run independent fresh review before any reviewed artifact can be created.
Keep all model admission and prohibited individual uses blocked.
